description: Exploratory initial-gradient Hessian probe with 0.25x internal gradient tolerance; 2 warmups and 3 interleaved repeats on 12 cases, independent original-input float64 quality. Ill-conditioned 4096 seed41 fails 1e-5 objective regression gate and both 4096 ill fixtures slow. Not integrated.
reproduction: Extract files into bench/sketch_speed and run PYTHONPATH=. python3 bench/sketch_speed/strict_compare.py; requires Apple GPU and native extension.
